title: Condition Watch Step on the Posted Daily Storage Rate
content:
The condition the lot is standing in adds a step to the posted daily rate on a storage agreement, because grain out of condition is watched and turned more often. This step is taken on Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements and is read from the grade of record and from the conditioning work the storage account shows.

## Clause

Where the grade of record is sample grade and the storage account carries a drying pass raised in the last six months, the out-of-condition step of 0.00055 for each bushel for each day is added to the posted daily rate.

Where the grade of record is US No. 3, or the storage account carries a drying pass raised in the last six months, the watch step of 0.00020 for each bushel for each day is added to the posted daily rate.

And otherwise no step is added.

## The combinations in full

| Grade of record | A drying pass raised in the last six months | Step added to the posted daily rate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| sample grade | yes | 0.00055 |
| sample grade | no | no step at all |
| US No. 3 | yes | 0.00020 |
| US No. 3 | no | 0.00020 |
| any other grade | yes | 0.00020 |
| any other grade | no | no step at all |

The heavier step of 0.00055 arises only where both particulars stand together: a grade of record of sample grade and a drying pass raised on the account within the last six months. Where the grade is sample grade and no pass has been raised in that window, neither limb of the second line is met and no step is added.

## Reading the six-month window

The window runs back six months from the day the charge is worked out, and what it looks for is a conditioning charge raised on this agreement's storage account inside it. A pass raised seven months ago is outside the window and does not turn the step on.

## Worked figures, on a hypothetical rate

Take a posted daily rate of 0.00200 for each bushel for each day.

**Grade of record sample grade, a drying pass raised two months ago.** The out-of-condition step of 0.00055 is added to the posted rate, giving 0.00255.

**Grade of record US No. 3, no pass in the window.** The watch step of 0.00020 is added, giving 0.00220.

**Grade of record US No. 2, a drying pass raised five months ago.** The drying pass alone carries the second line, so the watch step of 0.00020 is added, giving 0.00220.

**Grade of record US No. 1, no pass in the window.** No step is added, and the posted rate stands at 0.00200.
